items.name: platform
items.title: Platform context
items.description: Tells every Message UI component whether to render iOS 26 or macOS 26 metrics.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: Measured colors, screen-space bubble gradients, type scale, and spacing for iOS and macOS.

items.name: bubble-shape
items.title: Bubble shape
items.description: The traced native bubble outline and tail as SVG path and clip-path generators.

items.name: use-screen-space
items.title: Screen-space fill hook
items.description: Keeps bubble fills aligned to the screen-space gradient while a list scrolls.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message bubble
items.description: Native iOS 26 and macOS 26 bubbles: traced outline and tail, screen-space gradient fill, status, edited, reactions, and emoji-only messages.

items.name: tapback
items.title: Tapback
items.description: The native reaction balloon: six classic Tapbacks and custom emoji, own and others' colors, counts, and the selected state.

items.name: tapback-details
items.title: Tapback details
items.description: The surface "Tapback Details…" opens: who reacted and with what, as a sheet on iOS and an anchored popover on macOS, with your own reaction removable.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing indicator
items.description: The native typing bubble with its three staggered dots and trailing circles.

items.name: date-separator
items.title: Date separator
items.description: Date headers: the iOS two-line header with its service line, the mid-list one-liner, and the macOS variant.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link preview
items.description: The measured compact link card, plus a rich variant with an image, title and host.

items.name: message-attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: The document card Messages draws instead of a text bubble, with the file icon, name and size, in the bubble's own shape.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: A complete, composable conversation for either platform: header, scrolling log with clusters and reactions, typing state, and a composer. Bring your own data and send handler.

items.name: message-motion
items.title: Message motion
items.description: The measured send and receive animations, seekable so a harness can scrub them.

items.name: facetime-card
items.title: FaceTime card
items.description: A FaceTime link card in the native card style, plus the call states an application may want to show around it.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initials on the measured Messages gradient, a photo, or the generic silhouette, at native sizes.

items.name: macos-window
items.title: macOS window
items.description: The Messages window frame: traffic lights, sidebar and content slots, active and inactive states.

items.name: macos-sidebar
items.title: macOS sidebar
items.description: The conversation list sidebar with search, pinned conversations, rows, and selection states.

items.name: macos-header
items.title: macOS header
items.description: The translucent conversation header with compose, contact, and video controls.

items.name: macos-composer
items.title: macOS composer
items.description: The message field with the plus, audio, and emoji controls; Return sends.

items.name: tapback-bar
items.title: Tapback bar
items.description: The iOS Tapback picker pill with recent emoji and the emoji-picker bubble, plus the macOS two-row layout.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: iOS tinted message menu and the macOS NSMenu-style menu with Tapback rows.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message actions
items.description: The iOS long-press overlay: dim and blur, lifted bubble, Tapback bar, and menu, with the measured transition.

items.name: use-long-press
items.title: Long press hook
items.description: A cancelable 500 ms hold with keyboard, double-click, and right-click alternatives.

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message list
items.description: The scrolling log: clusters and tails, date headers, status labels, sender names, emoji-only rows, link cards, attachments, and the typing indicator.

items.name: ios-status-bar
items.title: iOS status bar
items.description: Time, Dynamic Island, cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery exactly as iOS 26 draws them.

items.name: ios-push-banner
items.title: Notification banner
items.description: The iOS 26 push banner, expanding out of the Dynamic Island on its recorded frames.

items.name: ios-nav-bar
items.title: iOS nav bar
items.description: The conversation nav bar with the glass back button, large avatar, and name pill, plus the list's large title.

items.name: ios-scroll-edge
items.title: iOS scroll edge
items.description: The wash iOS 26 lays over a message scrolling up under the conversation's floating nav bar, measured per theme.

items.name: ios-composer
items.title: iOS composer
items.description: The glass message field with the plus button, microphone, auto-growing text, and the send pill.

items.name: ios-conversation-list
items.title: iOS conversation list
items.description: The Messages list screen: large title, rows with avatars and previews, search pill, and compose button.

items.name: ios-new-message-sheet
items.title: iOS new message sheet
items.description: The New Message sheet with its close button and To field.

items.name: palette
items.title: Palette
items.description: Emits the measured light and dark palette as CSS variables for one platform.

items.name: ios-messages-app
items.title: iOS Messages app
items.description: The complete iOS 26 Messages app: list, conversation, New Message sheet, and the long-press overlay.

items.name: macos-messages-app
items.title: macOS Messages app
items.description: The complete macOS 26 Messages window: sidebar, header, message log, composer, and the right-click menu.

items.name: macos-plus-menu
items.title: macOS plus menu
items.description: The popover that opens from the composer's plus button: Photos, Stickers, Genmoji, Image Playground, #images, Message Effects.

items.name: macos-details
items.title: macOS conversation details
items.description: The inspector pane that slides in from the right of the window: contact, call actions, shared photos, links and documents, and the conversation options.

items.name: message-effects
items.title: Message effects
items.description: Send with effect on a bubble: the slam, loud and gentle animations and the Invisible Ink reveal, replayable on demand.

items.name: screen-effects
items.title: Screen effects
items.description: The full-screen send effects, drawn deterministically on a canvas so they can be scrubbed and screenshotted.

items.name: ios-effects-picker
items.title: iOS effects picker
items.description: The iOS "Send with effect" screen: the Bubble/Screen tabs, the effect rail, the preview bubble and its caption.

items.name: message-reply
items.title: Inline reply
items.description: The quoted stub above a reply, the reply-count affordance, and the focused thread view.

items.name: message-image
items.title: Photo message
items.description: Photos and videos in the bubble's shape, tail included, with the native multi-photo grid.

items.name: image-viewer
items.title: Photo viewer
items.description: The full-screen viewer a photo opens into: zoom out of the tile, swipe between the message's photos, pinch and pan, react, and drag down to close.

items.name: message-audio
items.title: Audio message
items.description: A voice message bubble with a waveform, play control, and a seekable position.

items.name: message-edit
items.title: Edit and undo send
items.description: Edit a sent message in place, the Edited label, and the undo-send removal.

items.name: ios-details
items.title: iOS conversation details
items.description: The details screen: contact, call actions, and the grouped settings cells.

items.name: group-details
items.title: iOS group details
items.description: A group conversation's details screen: the stacked group photo, an editable name, the members, and the shared photos and links.

items.name: ios-plus-menu
items.title: iOS plus menu
items.description: The attachment sheet with its app rows and the embedded photo grid.

items.name: photo-picker
items.title: iOS photo picker
items.description: The Photos panel under the composer: a scrolling three-column grid with the sheet grabber and tile selection.

items.name: sticker-picker
items.title: iOS sticker picker
items.description: The sheet the plus menu's Stickers row opens: category tabs, a search field, the sticker grid, and drag to place a sticker on a message.

items.name: ios-select-mode
items.title: iOS selection mode
items.description: Selection circles beside messages, the close button, and the bottom toolbar.

items.name: ios-search
items.title: iOS search
items.description: The search state of the conversation list: the field rising under the nav, a Cancel button, and results grouped into Conversations, Messages, Photos and Links.

items.name: ios-swipe-times
items.title: Swipe for times
items.description: The drag that shifts the conversation left to reveal per-message times.

items.name: ios-notices
items.title: Conversation notices
items.description: The unknown-sender notice, the failed-send badge, and the Not Delivered label.

items.name: system-message
items.title: System message
items.description: The centred grey lines that are not bubbles: group renames, joins and leaves, the group photo, a missed call, a reaction summary, and the unknown-sender sentence.

items.name: group-avatar
items.title: Group avatar
items.description: The stacked faces a group conversation shows in the list, the nav bar, the details header and the macOS sidebar.

items.name: audio-recorder
items.title: Audio recorder
items.description: The composer turning into a voice-message recorder: live waveform, running timer, and the send, stop and cancel controls.

items.name: index
items.title: Message UI
items.description: The whole kit: every component plus the conversation pane and both app shells.

items.name: theme-transition
items.title: Appearance switch
items.description: The system light/dark switch as iOS 26 plays it: a crossfade of about half a second, on two different curves in the two directions, from the recorded ramps.
